description: Java Expression Language injection — JSP EL, JSF EL, Spring SpEL, OGNL in non-Struts contexts, MVEL, JBoss EL

jsp_el_arithmetic.description: JSP/JSF Unified EL arithmetic evaluation — ${} and #{} syntax

probes.description: Basic JSP EL arithmetic. If the response contains 49, the server evaluates ${} expressions.
JSF deferred EL arithmetic. If 49 appears, the server evaluates #{} expressions.
EL with trailing garbage to distinguish real evaluation from static reflection. Only 49 appears if evaluated.

jsp_el_class_access.description: JSP EL class access via applicationScope or pageContext for information disclosure

probes.description: Dump application scope. If the server returns a Map dump, EL injection exists with read access to application state.
Extract server hostname via pageContext. Confirms EL injection with property traversal.
Access class loader via EL. A non-error response confirms deep object graph traversal.

spring_spel.description: Spring Expression Language (SpEL) injection via T() type expressions

probes.description: SpEL type expression calling Math.random(). A decimal number in the response proves SpEL evaluation.
SpEL RCE via Runtime.exec(). Do NOT use this in production — listed for detection of the injection point only. Match on the Process object reference or error.
SpEL environment variable dump. A map of environment variables confirms SpEL evaluation with system access.

ognl_non_struts.description: OGNL injection outside Apache Struts — Confluent, Atlassian products, custom OGNL evaluators

probes.description: OGNL arithmetic in %{} syntax. 49 in the response confirms OGNL evaluation.
OGNL context access to read the Host header. The hostname in the response confirms deep OGNL access.

mvel.description: MVEL expression injection — used in Drools, JBoss, Mule ESB

probes.description: MVEL arithmetic via @{} syntax. 49 in the response confirms MVEL evaluation.

error_based_blind.description: Blind EL injection via error-based detection — trigger a parse error with malformed expression

probes.description: Time-based blind SpEL. A 5-second delay in response confirms blind SpEL evaluation.
Blind EL via Thread.sleep. A 5-second delay confirms evaluation.
